history.note: Third detection - continued brightening, light curve consistent with SN rise

last_action_reasoning: CAND_01 at (658, 852) has now been observed for the third time. The source continues to show a clear brightening trend, with an estimated magnitude of 18.2, following previous measurements of 19.2 and 18.8. This consistent rising light curve over three consecutive observations, combined with its total absence in the reference image and its isolated point-source profile, confirms it as a real astronomical transient. The evolution is highly characteristic of a supernova in its early rising phase. While the difference image contains numerous subtraction artifacts near the bright star and diffraction spikes in the lower-left, CAND_01 is a clean, high-confidence detection. Triggering alert for spectroscopic follow-up.
